claim: Self-repair, under a matched sampling budget, is often not better than independent resampling and is bottlenecked by feedback quality.
quoted_support: Self-repair is not a silver bullet: when the cost of repair is taken into account, we find several instances in which pass rates are higher or equally high with i.i.d. sampling (without repair), especially when the budget is small.
